annotations.title: Get a healthy AI provider fallback

description: For AI API providers WhatsDownNow already tracks (OpenAI/ChatGPT, Anthropic/Claude, Gemini, Mistral, Groq, Perplexity, Cohere, xAI, DeepSeek, Together, Replicate, Hugging Face, OpenRouter, Fireworks), return currently healthy alternatives you can fail over to. Pass provider (slug or common name, e.g. 'openai' or 'chatgpt') for alternatives to one provider; omit it for the whole AI health board. Latency figures are from our HTTP probe of the public endpoint or status page, not model inference latency.

provider.description: AI provider slug or name, e.g. chatgpt, openai, claude, anthropic. Omit to list every AI API we track.
